newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Palestinians plea for EU pressure on Israel.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians plea for EU pressure on Israel.

text.p: The speaker of the Palestinian Legislative Council urged the European Union on Tuesday to put pressure on Israel to keep the Middle East peace process on track.
"The peace process...is in danger," Ahmed Ourie Abu Ala told a news conference at the European Parliament, the first visit to the assembly by a delegation from the Council.
He said the European Union should put pressure on the Israeli government to respect the letter and the spirit of the Olso peace accord and to stick to the timetable for implementing it.
Italian Socialist Euro-MP Luigi Alberto Colajanni said he expected the EU's directly elected assembly to approve a report on the peace process which he is to present next month.
The report will urge an EU ministerial delegation due shortly to visit the Middle East to put strong pressure on Israel to respect the Oslo agreement, Colajanni said.
Abu Ala said Israel must respect five crucial conditions if the peace process was to survive.
The government must implement the Oslo accord according to plan, stop building new Jewish settlements on Palestinian land and stop demolishing Arab houses in and around Jerusalem, Abu Ala said.
It must also immediately renew permanent negotiations with the Palestinian authorities, suspended since May, and stop isolating the Palestinian economy from the rest of the world.
"These are the five elements that make sense for peace. If not I can say the situation will be dangerous," Abu Ala warned.
